title: AAU Model Exit Exam
source: Addis Ababa University (AAU) Model Exit Exam — Moodle OCR

focusGuide.Database: Normalization, keys, ER diagrams, SQL updates, and functional dependencies.
focusGuide.Java/OOP: OOP concepts, package scope, exceptions, GC, and what Java cannot do (pointers).
focusGuide.Networking: OSI layers, TCP reliability, ICMP, ports, IPv4, CORS, and topology fault isolation.
focusGuide.Android: Services, lifecycle, src folder, licensing, and content providers.
focusGuide.Security: Saltzer-Schroeder principles, PKI, Triple DES, integrity, and malware types.
focusGuide.PM: Spiral model, risk retention, WBS tasks, critical path, and communication management.
focusGuide.AI/ML: Supervised learning, search algorithms (UCS, BFS, A*), and local search.
focusGuide.SE: SRS properties, requirements engineering, maintenance types, and testing process.
focusGuide.OS: Process creation, fork(), threads, memory mapping vs swapping, and program counter.
focusGuide.C++: Time complexity of loops and trace small code outputs.
focusGuide.Web: CSS types, JavaScript spread/async, DOM access, and HTTP status codes.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Queues, selection sort swaps, sorting complexity, and binary search.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Quality scenarios, layered architecture, coupling, and architecture goals.
focusGuide.General: Review lecture notes for any remaining topics.
